_doc: Per-spec dump byte ceilings (JSON.stringify(spec).length in the developer dump), enforced by test/reference/dump-size.test.ts (fb#1423).
Every unlisted spec is held to the default PER_SPEC_LIMIT_BYTES; a listed one only to its own ceiling, so one large spec never raises the bar for the rest.
Philosophy: SHRINK this file. Ceilings are shrink-only and the liveness test forces an entry to be lowered or deleted as its spec shrinks.
Never raise a ceiling casually; adding or raising an entry is a reviewed decision made in the same PR as the growth.
